note: About 4 miles west of LeRoy, on treed rolling land with a creek; a sand-bottomed swimming pool with a beach, a 9-hole grass-green golf course and a camp kitchen. Sites are grassed and naturally levelled. Campsites rent only to those 19 and older. --Claude
